svg.title: AI uses by team size
svg.desc: AI uses rated by team size. Summarising alerts: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Enrichment and context: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Explaining artefacts and log lines: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, can for large CDCs; Drafting search queries: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Drafting and converting detection rules: can for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Proposing a triage verdict: with caution for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Closing alerts without a human: avoid for teams of one to three, with caution for dedicated CDCs, with caution for large CDCs; Investigation support: with caution for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Summarising threat intelligence: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Drafting reports and reviews: should for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs; Drafting statutory notifications: with caution for teams of one to three, with caution for dedicated CDCs, with caution for large CDCs; Agents investigating on their own: avoid for teams of one to three, with caution for dedicated CDCs, can for large CDCs; Automated containment: avoid for teams of one to three, with caution for dedicated CDCs, with caution for large CDCs; Training and onboarding material: can for teams of one to three, should for dedicated CDCs, should for large CDCs.
svg.text: Every use comes with conditions, listed in the table below the chart.
